items.title: Iconic Artwork 'Virtually Destroyed' In Crimea Drone Strike
items.description: A massive panorama depicting a battle in the 1853-1856 Crimean War has been heavily damaged by what Russian-occupation authorities in Sevastopol say was a Ukrainian drone attack.

items.title: Ethiopia must not be dragged back into war
items.description: TPLF hardliners, backed by Eritrea, are threatening to drag Ethiopia back into a war its people have already rejected.

items.title: PM’s aide Urich charged with leaking classified info with intent to harm state security
items.description: State Attorney’s Office indicts adviser over passing Hamas memo to Bild in 2024 amid domestic anger at Netanyahu after hostages' murder; is also charged with destroying evidence The post PM’s aide Urich charged with leaking classified info with intent to harm state security appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: In Gaza, UN inquiry reports Hamas abuses against Palestinians
items.description: A report published Tuesday, June 9, under the auspices of the United Nations details abuses committed by the Islamist group to 'eliminate opposition and control Gaza,' targeting rival clans and alleged 'collaborators' with Israel. The Israeli army has been shelling the enclave since 2023.

items.title: War in Ukraine now longer than WWI: Russia's full scale invasion reached 1,569 days
items.description: 1,569 days – four years and three months: That is how long Russia's war in Ukraine has lasted. It is a milestone, surpassing the duration of World War One. The two conflicts are often compared for their brutal infantry assaults and heavy casualties. For more, FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv, Ukraine.

items.title: In the Ukraine war, new ground-based drones are playing a key role on the battlefield
items.description: Ukraine relies on robotic warfare to punch above its weight on the battlefield, including shifting frontline duties from soldiers to land drones.

items.title: Why is Hezbollah still important for Iran?
items.description: Although weakened, the Lebanon-based Hezbollah militant group remains a central piece of Iran's power projection in the Middle East. Tehran has insisted they be included in any peace deal with the US and Israel.

items.title: ‘The day never stops’ for aid workers braving missiles and drones in Ukraine
items.description: As Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine enters its fifth year, conditions in southern Ukraine have rapidly deteriorated. Maintaining humanitarian operations has become an increasingly complex balancing act between enabling aid delivery and managing risk.

items.title: Syria flips the script. It’s an island of calm in the stormy Middle East.
items.description: Decades of dictatorship culminated in 15 years of war and turmoil in Syria. But with the U.S.-Iran war, a relatively peaceful Syria is now an outpost of progress and hope in the Middle East.

items.title: Inside Myanmar, rebels are losing ground as military forces men into army
items.description: The BBC travels with rebels to frontline positions in Myanmar to see how the war is unfolding.

items.description: The bombing follows a string of assassination plots inside Russia targeting military officials, pro-war figures and Ukrainian defectors since the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
